newsitem.title: GERMANY: East German utilities join in telcoms venture.
newsitem.headline: East German utilities join in telcoms venture.

text.p: Five eastern German power utilities have formed a venture to offer regional telecommunications services for businesses and institutions, the daily Die Welt reported on Tuesday.

Regionale Telekommunikations gesellschaft mbH (RegioTel) has 2,000 kilometers of fiber optic cable in the former East Germany, and would offer voice, data, and Internet services to local businesses, universities, hospitals and savings banks.
Each partner held a 20 percent stake in the venture. Together they have annual revenue of about five billion marks.

They include Energieversorgung Sachsen-Ost AG in Dresden, Energieversorgung Spree/Schwarze Elster AG in Cottbus, Energieversorgung Suedsachsen AG in Chemnitz , Mitteldeutsche Energieversorgung AG in Halle and Westsaechsische Energie AG in Markkleeberg.
